repos.readme_excerpt:
# agent-desktop

Computer use for AI agents: read and operate desktop apps through the OS accessibility tree.

A CLI and C library for macOS, Windows and Linux. A snapshot returns JSON with a ref for every element an agent can act on. The agent acts on a ref and snapshots again to check, with no pixel matching; the loop stays in your agent.

Every CLI call runs in its own process. Headless calls still prohibit foreground activation and synthesized input.

Snapshots, clipboard reads, screenshots, command output and debug artifacts can contain private desktop content. Keep them out of public logs and uploads. The optional JEV helper sends screen descriptions to a configured model provider; it is separate from the native CLI. See privacy and data handling.

repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repos.readme_excerpt:
🇻🇳 Tiếng Việt •

Persistent memory compression system built for Claude Code .

How It Works •

Claude-Mem seamlessly preserves context across sessions by automatically capturing tool usage observations, generating semantic summaries, and making them available to future sessions. This enables Claude to maintain continuity of knowledge about projects even after sessions end or reconnect.

# Quick Start

Install claude-mem for Grok Bot:

Grok Bot has no host hooks, so we watch the chat log files. Default is CMEM Pro, the hosted memory. Local observer is opt-in: --provider host. Installing this plugin does not install Cursor.

Awareness push pilot (LFG + Orifice): needle observations (decision, bugfix, security_alert, sensitive) are appended as dated - YYYY-MM-DD [awareness] … lines into that bot's memory/log/YYYY-MM.md. Grok Bot already re-reads the log from disk. This does not write profile.md, user-memory, or project memory. Disable with CLAUDE_MEM_GROK_BOT_AWARENESS_ENABLED=false.

Effortless Web Scraping for the Modern Web

Scrapling is a Python Web Scraping framework that brings fast HTTP requests, stealth browsers, powerful parsing, and concurrent crawling into one library.

Scrape static pages, render JavaScript, interact with websites, and extract data from the API calls behind them. Build crawlers with reusable sessions, proxy rotation, automatic retries, pause/resume, and built-in data exports.

Use it from Python, the terminal, or your AI agent through its MCP server and Agent Skill. From extracting a few fields to collecting a whole website as clean Markdown, Scrapling covers the full scraping workflow.

# What you can do with Scrapling

• Fetch & interact: Fast HTTP requests, stealth browsers, JavaScript rendering, Cloudflare Turnstile/Interstitial handling, persistent sessions, and background API capture.

• Parse & extract: CSS, XPath, text and regex search, adaptive element tracking, similar-element matching, and clean Markdown output.

repos.description: FreeToken brings datacenter-scale model serving to your desktop. Run massive models locally, fast and efficiently.
repos.readme_excerpt:
Unlock datacenter-class intelligence on the hardware you already own — Run 290B+ frontier MoE models locally on your gaming PC at blistering interactive speeds.

# About

FreeToken is an edge-native Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) serving engine designed for running frontier-scale open-weight models on personal and consumer hardware. It treats heterogeneous edge resources—GPUs, CPUs, host memory, and interconnects—as a unified, elastic inference platform. Its core features include:

• Fast Edge-Native Runtime: Provides efficient MoE serving with bandwidth-adaptive CPU–GPU co-execution ($q^\star$ policy), full-layer double-buffered prefill streaming, global LRU expert caching, graph-compatible execution, and the FTW fast weight format.

• Semantic-Aware Caching: Features semantic anchor checkpoints for recurrent state and KV caches, allowing agentic context edits (e.g., tool calls, thinking blocks) to avoid redundant context recomputation.

# T3 Code

T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface". It enables control of the agents on your machine with a best-in-class mobile app (iOS, Android), web app and Electron-based desktop app.

Works with your subscriptions on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, and fx. If they're set up on your computer, T3 Code can control them.

# "Wait, what are you selling me?"

Nothing. We built T3 Code because we wanted the best possible development experience with agents. We were inspired by existing solutions like the Codex desktop app, Conductor, Claude Desktop and Cursor Glass, but none met our bar.

We wanted something performant, remote-ready, and truly open. If we ever go the wrong direction, we want you to have everything you need to fork and build the editor that you want.

> Kronos is the first open-source foundation model for financial candlesticks (K-lines), > trained on data from over 45 global exchanges.

# 📰 News

• 🚩 [2025.11.10] Kronos has been accpeted by AAAI 2026.

Kronos is a family of decoder-only foundation models, pre-trained specifically for the "language" of financial markets—K-line sequences. Unlike general-purpose TSFMs, Kronos is designed to handle the unique, high-noise characteristics of financial data. It leverages a novel two-stage framework:

• A specialized tokenizer first quantizes continuous, multi-dimensional K-line data (OHLCV) into hierarchical discrete tokens.

repos.description: The best ChatGPT that $100 can buy.
repos.readme_excerpt:
# nanochat

nanochat is the simplest experimental harness for training LLMs. It is designed to run on a single GPU node, the code is minimal/hackable, and it covers all major LLM stages including tokenization, pretraining, finetuning, evaluation, and inference. For example, you can train your own GPT-2 capability LLM (which cost ~$43,000 to train in 2019) for only $48 (~2 hours of 8XH100 GPU node) and then talk to it over a simple CLI. On a spot instance, the total cost can be closer to ~$15. More generally, nanochat is configured out of the box to train an entire miniseries of compute-optimal models by setting one single complexity dial: --depth, the number of layers in the GPT transformer model (GPT-2 capability happens to be approximately depth 26). All other hyperparameters (the width of the transformer, number of heads, learning rate adjustments, training horizons, weight decays, ...) are calculated automatically in an optimal way.

ai.category_reason: LLM 학습·평가·추론 도구이지만, 레포의 핵심은 GPT 같은 대규모 언어 모델을 직접 훈련하는 프레임워크이므로 LLM 자체 개발 인프라로 분류했다. LLM·에이전트(LLM 서비스나 에이전트 앱)와는 다르다.
ai.summary_ko: 단일 GPU 노드에서 GPT-2 수준의 언어 모델을 2시간에 $48 정도의 비용으로 훈련할 수 있는 실험용 프레임워크다. 토크나이제이션부터 사전학습, 미세조정, 평가, 추론까지 LLM의 전체 파이프라인을 최소한의 코드로 구현했으며, 단 하나의 파라미터(`--depth`)로 모든 하이퍼파라미터를 자동 계산한다.

repos.readme_excerpt:
# Heretic

# Training-free language model modification

Remove censorship, suppress slop, reduce sycophancy, and more. All in an afternoon, on your gaming PC.

# Modify any LLM that you can run on your hardware[^1]

[^1]: Heretic supports on-the-fly 4-bit model quantization with bitsandbytes, which can reduce the amount of VRAM required to process a model to the same amount that is used to run a typical quantized version of it, at a slight accuracy cost. Set the quantization option to bnb_4bit to enable this.

Heretic is a unique tool that lets you do what only corporations with access to massive computing power usually do: Modify, rather than merely run, language models. It does not perform expensive training; rather, it uses a collection of mathematical techniques to steer behavior based on contrasting example prompts and matching scorers.

Heretic can, depending on the configuration:

• Suppress refusals/remove censorship (this is the default action)
